combo.description: W, E, R and Flash to InSec your enemy. Then Q, AA, AA, W and AA again to finish.
W towards your target as you E and R them. Then AA your target down to take them out.
Use your E then W. Press Q then AA, AA, R and AA.
Use your E, then Q, AA, AA, AA and then R and AA to finish.
W E your enemy and press your Q, then AA, AA, AA and then W again!
AA your target then E. Pop your Q and then AA, AA, AA and AA!
